The [[Stygian Aegis]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by both the [[Stygian Lord (mesmer)|mesmer Stygian Lord]] and the [[Stygian Lord (necromancer)|necromancer Stygian Lord]], who can be found in [[Stygian Veil]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Motivation]])
:Armor +10 (vs. [[Demon]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Plagueborn Shield]] dyed red.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the +10 armor versus Demons is not an available [[inscription]]. The other (unique) versions of this shield are the:
*[[Aegis of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh]] [[Tactics|(tactics)]]
*[[Aegis of Terror]] [[Strength|(strength)]]
*[[Stygian Defender]] [[Command|(command)]]
